---
title: "Road accidents in Zurich {{< var yr_span >}}"
subtitle: "English summary. The full site is in German; all data files and the data catalogue are bilingual."
lang: en
pagetitle: "Zurich road accidents – English summary"
---

```{r}
#| include: false
source("../_helpers.R")
jahr <- rd("data/jahr.csv")
dq <- rd("dq/dq_ergebnisse.csv")
eff <- rd("trackx/wetter_effekt.csv")
met <- rd("modell/schwere_metriken.csv")
tot <- sum(jahr$unfaelle); inj <- sum(jahr$unfaelle[jahr$schwere_kurz != "Sachschaden"])
fatal <- sum(jahr$unfaelle[jahr$schwere_kurz == "Getötete"])
tj <- jahr |> group_by(jahr) |> summarise(n = sum(unfaelle), i = sum(unfaelle[schwere_kurz != "Sachschaden"]), s = sum(unfaelle[schwere_kurz == "Sachschaden"]), .groups = "drop")
ch <- function(col, y) round(100 * (tj[[col]][tj$jahr == y] / tj[[col]][tj$jahr == y - 1] - 1))
r <- function(o, t) eff[eff$zielgroesse == o & eff$term == t, ]
ra <- r("Alle Unfälle", "regenRegen"); ri <- r("Unfälle mit Personenschaden", "regenRegen"); rv <- r("Unfälle mit Velo", "regenRegen")
mv <- function(m, k) met$test[met$modell == m & met$metrik == k]
n_chk <- nrow(dq); n_stop <- sum(dq$schwere == "STOP"); n_warn <- sum(dq$status == "WARN")
en <- function(x) gsub("’", ",", x)
```

```{r}
tiles(
  tile(en(fi(tot)), paste("accidents", yr_span), "road traffic accidents in the City of Zurich"),
  tile(en(fi(inj)), "with injured or killed", sprintf("%s %% of all accidents", fdec(100 * inj / tot, 1))),
  tile(fatal, "fatal accidents", "at least one person killed"),
  tile(n_chk, "automated checks", sprintf("%d violated STOP checks, %d %s", 0, n_warn, if (n_warn == 1) "warning" else "warnings"))
)
```

This site turns the open road-accident data of the City of Zurich and the Swiss Federal Roads Office (FEDRO/ASTRA) into a **quality-checked** analysis. A pipeline in R and SQL (DuckDB) downloads the sources, runs automated data-quality checks, and only if no blocking (STOP) check fails does it build models, exports and this website. Where the data have limits, the limit is stated next to the chart. The site is aimed at both citizens and professionals in official statistics. The pages are in German; this page summarises the essentials.

## Key findings

::: {.findings-en}
- **Data quality is a release condition.** `r n_chk` automated checks (`r n_stop` with STOP effect, which would abort the pipeline) ran on the latest snapshot; none is violated. `r if (n_warn == 1) "One warning remains" else "Warnings remain"` visible on purpose: the **structural break of 2015**`r if (n_warn == 1) "" else " is one of them"`. The number of recorded accidents jumps by +`r ch("n", 2015)` % that year, while accidents with injuries rise by only +`r ch("i", 2015)` % and property-damage-only accidents by +`r ch("s", 2015)` %. This reflects a change in recording practice, not a real increase on the roads. Time series across 2015 must be read with that caveat. [German page: Datenqualität](../datenqualitaet.qmd)
- **Detect, repair, verify.** Errors are never silently corrected: a check finds them (e.g. 9 invalid geometries, 40 impossible weather readings), a documented repair in the staging layer fixes them (`ST_MakeValid`; setting impossible values to NULL), and a second STOP check on the cleaned data proves the repair worked.
- **When.** On weekdays accidents peak in the morning and late afternoon commute; after midnight there are fewer accidents but a larger share involves injuries. [Wann](../wann.qmd)
- **Weather.** In rain there are about **+`r round(100 * (ra$irr - 1))` % more accidents per hour** (95 % CI +`r round(100 * (ra$ci_low - 1))` % to +`r round(100 * (ra$ci_high - 1))` %), +`r round(100 * (ri$irr - 1))` % for accidents with injuries, at the same time of day, season and temperature (negative-binomial model, incident rate ratios). For bicycle accidents there is no detectable rain effect (IRR `r fdec(rv$irr, 2)`, CI includes 1). Warmth goes with many more bicycle accidents. This is per hour, not per trip: exposure (traffic volume) is unknown. [Wetter](../wetter.qmd)
- **Severity.** A model predicting whether an accident involved injury (test-set ROC-AUC `r fdec(mv("Random Forest", "roc_auc"), 2)` for the random forest, `r fdec(mv("Logistische Regression", "roc_auc"), 2)` for logistic regression, versus 0.50 for guessing the base rate) mostly learns that accidents involving **bicycles, motorcycles or pedestrians** much more often cause injury. It shows association, not causation, and is not a prediction tool. [Schwere](../schwere.qmd)
- **Where.** Per resident, small inner-city quarters (Hochschulen, City, Lindenhof) have the highest rates because few people live there and many pass through. Rates start in 2015 because of the structural break. [Wo](../wo.qmd), [Karte](../karte.qmd)
:::

## Method in brief

- **Layers:** raw (untouched copy) → staging (typed, documented cleaning) → mart (enriched, aggregated). Only marts are exported.
- **Quality gate:** checks come from three sources: data contracts (pointblank), SQL checks with metadata in the file header, and history checks against the previous snapshot. Each is STOP or WARN, optionally with a tolerance. Checks are themselves tested with deliberately broken fixtures.
- **Reproducibility:** container image pinned by digest, R packages from a dated snapshot (2025-10-30), `{targets}` for orchestration, dated data snapshots with SHA-256 manifest, GitHub Actions with SHA-pinned actions. [Pipeline & Methode](../pipeline.qmd)
- **Metadata:** DCAT-AP CH catalogue (JSON-LD) prepared for I14Y / opendata.swiss (not submitted), bilingual data dictionary. [Daten & Metadaten](../daten.qmd)
- **Privacy by design:** only year, month, weekday and hour are published, never exact dates. A non-public file with exact timestamps is used only inside the pipeline; only model coefficients and coarse classes with at least 10 cases leave it, enforced by an automated, self-testing privacy gate. No cookies, no tracking, no web fonts; the map background (CARTO) is the only third-party request. [Datenschutz](../datenschutz.qmd)

## Data and licence

Download everything from [Daten & Metadaten](../daten.qmd) (CSV, Parquet, GeoJSON, JSON-LD). The machine-readable catalogue is [katalog.jsonld](../export/meta/katalog.jsonld); a plain-text summary for software agents is [llms.txt](../llms.txt).
